title: Business brief dev acceptance: a thinking model's reading is read, not cut off, and Read menu again asks only for a place with a Menu
steps: S1: Call the business reading step with a model answer that follows a long reasoning part, with the answer in a json code fence, cut off by the token limit, empty, and not JSON.
S2: Ask menuAgainTarget for the Read menu again preview with a detail answer that has no Menu and one that has a Menu.
expect: S1: the long-reasoning answer and the fenced answer are read; the cut-off answer falls back to rules with reason truncated; empty and not JSON give reason empty and unreadable.
S2: no target without a Menu, the opportunity id with a Menu.
evidence: On dev a business reading settled at its 12 cent ceiling and was stored unreadable; Details of a non-food place called research-again with parts menu-file and menu-photos
fence: Pure functions: the reading parser and the menu preview target, run without a database or a model

tests: Read menu again asks for a preview only when the place has a Menu
a thinking model that reasons as it did on dev still has room to answer, and the answer is read
an answer in a json code fence is read
an answer cut off by the token limit falls back to the rules, and says it was cut off
an empty answer and an answer that is not JSON are told apart
